title: Member Pickup Fee Tariff Clause — Northgate Purchases & Returns Special Orders
content:
Tariff clause for the member pickup fee on the changed-mind freight pickup of Northgate Special Order merchandise bought through Northgate Purchases & Returns on a consumer-segment membership (Northgate Student Club, Heroes Club, Club or Club Plus Membership).

## Clause

The member pickup fee is the channel's changed-mind pickup fee for the pickup, rounded half up to the cent.

| Term | Meaning |
|---|---|
| The authorization | the return authorization the member is confirming (recorded as submitted); the fee is entered against its sale line |
| The channel's changed-mind pickup fee | the Northgate Special Order changed-mind freight pickup fee in the channel's return fee schedule, charged once for the pickup |
| Rounding | half up to the cent, once, on the final member pickup fee |

## Readings

- The fee is one entry per pickup, entered as a return pickup fee against the sale line on the authorization being confirmed.
- Hypothetical: a member confirming a freight pickup authorization for a sectional sofa is charged the channel's changed-mind pickup fee for that pickup, as one return pickup fee entry against the sofa's sale line.
